name: Image Carousel
author: pfg
description: A small graphics demo that shows a carousel of detailed dithered pictures, such as a mountain landscape, in just four colors.

descriptions.en: A small graphics demo that shows a carousel of detailed dithered pictures, such as a mountain landscape, in just four colors.
descriptions.it: Una piccola demo grafica che mostra una serie di immagini retinate e dettagliate, come un paesaggio di montagna, in soli quattro colori.
